## Description

UI-02 presents labelled Member, Role and Action facts in aligned rows, with an active-row heading count separate from product-access seats. Quiet native Remove…/Leave… disclosures use trusted subject identity; only the final confirmation is red. Compact desktop rows grow for long values, enlarged text and expanded content while preserving server safeguards, recovery and approved help.

Stacked on [UI-01 #263](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/263) at `37046bbd`, the source candidate remains `614090a1` on main `9507e751`. Source, tests and quality are unchanged from published v1. The current local Linux AMD64 image now passes at this exact head, including the complete offline build and seven runtime cases.

Architecture: T0: no architecture fact
The sole tier reason remains trusted `read_paths` for the browser inventory in `docs/implementation/test-gate-policy.md`; commands, gate selection and authority are unchanged.

**Architecture facts** (`614090a1` against actual parent/merge base `37046bbd`):

All committed `.pr-impact.json` classification flags remain false. Production architecture is unchanged within Web, retaining complete reads, protected mutations, identity/count meanings, provider operations, outcomes and lifetimes. No new public declaration, component/dependency, state store or deployment boundary is introduced.

Root accepted source/quality/checker reasons and the current image result. V1 body/comments were published and byte-readback verified. [V2 image proof and immutable history](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/d80073505ccf446e247d50886c5f721c908d9dbf/review-evidence/ui-02/614090a1632b27ce40a3d2e38cac9492bac048aa/v2/README.md) retain exact inputs, logs, cleanup and prior report links.

**Overall merge status: blocked; Draft.** The complete selected hosted-live group and independent authorized current-head human approval remain required. Six proven quota setup failures and the separate application 503 retain unknown correlation; no provider cause or new live pass is inferred. UI-01 being Ready supplies neither hold. No merge/deployment occurred; root records actual v2 publication/readback separately.
